verdict.rationale: Attio documents a public JSON-over-HTTPS REST API with an OpenAPI 3.1 spec, OAuth, token-based access (ATTIO_API_TOKEN), and 429/Retry-After rate-limit semantics, so its data can be driven programmatically without the UI. Signed webhooks also allow event-driven automation. However, nothing documents running the product in CI, and the only CLI evidence is an app-SDK migration command. Missing for 10: explicit headless/CI usage docs or examples, a documented general-purpose CLI for automation, service-account/API-key provisioning guidance for unattended jobs, independent hands-on corroboration.
